name: motif_edit_phoneme
description:
Edit a phoneme's representations. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use only if a phoneme has another written form of the same sound, such as a digraph; otherwise author a phoneme for a real contrast. HermitCrab reads the longest spelling first (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages new written representations for an existing phoneme, or respells one it has, so a multigraph such as ng, ts or dy is another way the same segment is written and never a second phoneme. It refuses a spelling another phoneme or boundary already has, and a respelling that an environment writes. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-edit-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.

add.description: New representations to append, each an object with a representation, such as ng.

respell.description: Current representations to replace in place, each with from and to.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
